name: Digital Transformations in Health and Human Services
description: Current and emerging technologies present a plethora of possibilities in the health and human services. This course challenges learners to examine the potentials and the barriers of evolving technologies in these sectors. Through the lens of the health and human service manager, learners examine the impact of the increasing reliance on and use of technology by individuals, organizations, and society. Learners develop strategies for implementing technology-enabled change initiatives while addressing the associated ethics and privacy issues.
